lines: Phases 1 to 5 complete. Phase 6 in progress. The decision asked of Brandon in Status 236 at about 5:20 PM MT Friday stands unanswered: move on to the film and the masters, or one more round of looks first. The work goes on in either case and only the freeze waits. Two smaller words will be asked of him as their pictures at 4K come in, each a yes or no: the level line's second candidate, its report due by 4:45 AM MT, and the first what-if of the change of season, summer's sand mound, its 4K frames due by about 4:55 AM MT.

Chain 46, the cure of film frame 2828's one odd drawing: its measuring run is back and I read its report whole. Measured here: every measure line and the gate lines equal chain 45's character for character, all eight guard stills carry the list's values, and summer's review picture is the same bytes as chain 45's. Stated by the helper: the whole test run 1,146 passed and 8 skipped. One thing holds the gate: four 4K frames at the peaks of the change of season must come out equal to chain 45's to the byte. The first, film frame 2836, is equal. The other three are due by about 4:47 AM MT. Until then the cure is not on the main branch.

The level line, item 286, decision 301: all 14 pictures at 3840 are read and measured. At the masters' size it is no line: in spring at rest the level passage climbs 13.6 levels over 8 rows right of the trunk on the main branch, soft to the eye. So the film and the stills need no mend and the item is a matter of the live page in the storm alone. The first candidate stays not offered. The places the helpers named are each ruled: the cream patches on summer's base are sun on the stone's shoulder, no fault; the green band low in fall is pooled fog, no fault; the upright line above fall's chimney is the crack's second line, no fault, and joins fall's list for a round three. One new open item, 290: summer's chimney stones read soft from the close camera at 4K. No edit is ordered for it.

The counter of broken pixels that works on Windows, decision 302: its builder's floors report is read whole. Four of its five floors are taken as met as stated: the whole test run with 1,132 passed and 8 skipped, what lives on the card, the counter itself with 27 pictures the same bytes, and a master's frame at 3840 equal to the byte. The fifth, the pace, read 1.95 percent quicker than the main branch, which cannot be true; its builder says the machine was unsteady and I agree. The pace is being drawn again, twice, by 4:50 AM MT. It merges as chain 47 after chain 46 lands. It changes nothing in the picture.

The change of season's first what-if, decision 303: summer's sand mound leaving the table in the shake into fall. On the main branch the mound keeps its peak and slides away as one body over three frames. In the what-if grains lift off its skin, the peak slumps under a puff and a thinning cloud drifts off, five frames in all. I looked at its builder's sheet of 17 frames before and after. Stated by its builder: 1,139 tests passed, all eight guard stills unchanged, the frames before the leaving the same bytes. Open: the puff reads paler than the lying sand in one frame, measured here on the sheet, and a few pixels differ by one level in frames where no sand moves, not explained yet. Four helpers are drawing film frames 2107 to 2110 at 3840 before and after. It stands on its own branch and nothing of it is on the main branch.

The render instructions for his computer: no new word from the builder since Status 260. Its hosted test run stood at 8 of 10 jobs green and its last report is due by about 4:50 AM MT. One finding of it is not ruled yet: the main branch's newest shader change moved a little what hosted Windows draws through Direct3D 11; stated by the builder, the floors hold with at least 2.5 dB of room.

Remaining in phase 6 and what he receives. The render instructions: one file in the repo and one line to give Claude Code. The what-ifs for the change of season and for the live page's stand when it is shaken early, each shown before and after, none merged without his word. On his word the freeze: the repo goes private and the references are redrawn. Then the film steps of the build order and the full 4K 60 render on his gaming PC on his word: With Prompt and Without Prompt at 3840x2160, the Portfolio Looping Video and the Portfolio Screenshot. Last the fresh review and BUILD COMPLETE.

Sound credits 7,420 of 10,000 (measured from the ledger at 4:13 AM MT: 52 calls), no call since 05:47 UTC on Thursday (10:47 PM MT Wednesday). No film render. No new preview since Preview 08. The live page is the sixteenth publish, unchanged since 2:57 AM MT.
